title: Medicare and Medicaid Programs; CY 2027 Payment Policies Under the Physician Fee Schedule and Other Changes to Part B Payment and Coverage Policies; Medicare Shared Savings Program Requirements; and Medicare Prescription Drug Inflation Rebate Program
abstract: CMS proposes CY 2027 payment and policy changes for the Medicare Physician Fee Schedule and other Medicare Part B issues, including updates to the Medicare Prescription Drug Inflation Rebate Program, the Ambulatory Specialty Model, the Medicare Shared Savings Program, the Quality Payment Program, and payment policies for Rural Health Clinics, Federally Qualified Health Centers, ambulance services, and clinical laboratories. Comments are due September 14, 2026.
